    About Del Webb in Lakewood Ranch

    Welcome to the ultimate 55+ community, Del Webb in Lakewood Ranch. This is the place to be if you want to experience the very best of Southwest Florida living.

    With around 1,300 personalized new construction homes and a ton of resort-style amenities, Del Webb has everything you need to enjoy the Florida lifestyle to the fullest. You'll never get bored here.  They've got their own lifestyle director to help you find social events and activities to keep you entertained.

     

    This is one of the largest green certified communities in the area, so you can feel good about your environmental impact while living your best life. Whether you're hitting the fitness center, arts and crafts room, or game room at the 21,000 square foot clubhouse, or enjoying the resort-style pool, bocce ball courts, pickleball and tennis courts, or outdoor fire pits, Del Webb has something for everyone.
